ctx.x: You told me already about how you all slaughtered Goodman in Chicago---Fats Waller sat in with you all.

They were good. I like Tommy, I liked Tommy's band, I liked Glen Miller's band. And Woody had a good band. And what's the guy played with Bob Hope? Les Brown and his Band of Renown, I liked him. We played against him when he was still in school. I like them bands, they were good.

Collectively they were nice, but when you come to individual solos they didn't stack up to the soul brothers. Soul brothers would eat 'em up. Because they didn't think like we did. You see, rhythm is your heritage. That's us. And dancing, singing is our heritage.
